## changed: `Projects/Habait/habait-walkaround/Habait/studio/dashboard/app.js`
**Cards 04, 06, 07.** Before: one page, a side list, 16 identical players, raw floats, a light/orange look of its own. After: a hash router (#/ · #/new · #/p/<id>, old #<id> links still work) with הפרויקטים שלי (cards: cover + AI badge, status chip in words, spend via fmtCost; three-part empty state), a two-field new-project wizard, and the project page: 1 upload (keyboard drop zone, a row per file with progress/remove/retry, an editable role chip suggested from extension, name and PDF page count, stored in `notes` as one `[roles] {json}` line), 'מה המערכת הבינה' (confidence once, each `uncertainties` entry flagged on the field it names), 2 create (estimate on the button, a 9-step timeline in words + m:ss, never a percentage), 3 results (exterior / building — 'עוד לא בשרשרת הזו' / apartment with room clips collapsed), advanced collapsed (all old controls, stage table, log). Same API calls only. A 405 turns on one 'מצב תצוגה — שמירה כבויה' banner; refusals show on their row. Evidence `logs/c06-studio.txt`, `logs/c07-studio.txt`, frames `after/studio/`. ## changed: `Projects/Habait/tools/deploy-vercel/stage_flow.py`
**Card 03.** Before: `_local` excluded whole, so `_local/dist/rainbow/846/apartment.json` 404'd on the site and the landing gallery fell back to clay. After: a new step 1b stages `_local/dist/<project>/<unit>/` for each project the site stages: `apartment.json`, `media/**` and the ZIP the manifest links (`zip.src`); never `index.html`/`assets/`, never `_local/segments` or `_local/projects`. 29 files, 10.1 MB for rainbow/846. Deterministic (two runs byte-identical lists). Evidence `development/tasks/platform-ui-ux/logs/c03-stage.txt`. **Takes effect only on the next deploy, with its own go (root §9).** Note: the live script cannot run today (OWED-023: platform `node_modules/three` missing).
